- memory_id "1000116": The indexer is owned by the Cinder team.  (about: Cinder team, indexer)
- memory_id "1000254": Since 2025-03-07, the billing API is owned by the Ember team.  (about: billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000240": The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Ember team.  (about: webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000043": feature-flags is owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000033": The ledger service is owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000237": From 2025-03-03, the pager for the webhook dispatcher rings the Ember team.  (about: webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000198" [decision]: Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team starting 2025-02-12; Tomasz is off rotation.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000271": The image resizer is owned by the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000261" [decision]: Lena takes over the pager rotation for the Boreal team from Marcus in the cycle starting 2025-03-17.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000063": The Boreal team owns the notifier.  (about: Boreal team, notifier)
- memory_id "1000145": The reporting service depends on the ledger service for the nightly balance export.  (about: ledger service, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000138": The authentication gateway is owned by the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000167": The notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01 during INC-2025-004.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000150": Oskar runs the weekly architecture review.  (about: Oskar, weekly architecture review)
- memory_id "1000174" [constraint]: Deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000230" [decision]: Yuki Tanaka is on call for the Cinder team this cycle, taking over from Diego.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Cinder team, Diego)
